title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #12

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How can a smile help others? (1 mark)
   A. It hurts them
   B. It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   C. It has no effect
   D. It makes them angry

2. Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry? (1 mark)
   A. Break things
   B. Take deep breaths and count to ten
   C. Hit the person
   D. Shout at everyone

3. What should you do if you make a wrong choice? (1 mark)
   A. Repeat it
   B. Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   C. Hide it
   D. Blame others

4. Which action shows respect for a grandmother? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting at her
   B. Laughing at her
   C. Ignoring her greeting
   D. Helping her to carry water

5. Who is your cousin? (1 mark)
   A. Your mother's sister
   B. The child of your aunt or uncle
   C. Your father's father
   D. Your teacher

6. Which action shows reverence for God? (1 mark)
   A. Handling the Bible with care
   B. Laughing in church
   C. Talking during prayer
   D. Throwing the Bible

7. What does it mean to repent? (1 mark)
   A. To blame others
   B. To pretend nothing happened
   C. To run away
   D. To be sorry for sin and turn away from it

8. What did Zacchaeus promise to give to the poor? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. One tenth
   C. All his possessions
   D. Half of his possessions

9. Which lesson do we learn from Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore God
   B. Curse enemies
   C. Follow money
   D. Obey God and speak only what He says

10. What does it mean to fear God? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore Him
   B. To respect and love Him and obey Him
   C. To run from Him
   D. To be terrified of Him

11. What position did Pharaoh give Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd
   B. Soldier
   C. Second in command over Egypt
   D. Priest

12. Which city did Abram come from? (1 mark)
   A. Jerusalem
   B. Jericho
   C. Ur
   D. Nazareth

13. Which verse says that nothing is impossible with God? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Luke 7:14
   D. Luke 15:8

14. Where was Bartimaeus sitting when Jesus passed? (1 mark)
   A. By the roadside near Jericho
   B. At a market
   C. On a boat
   D. In the temple

15. What did Jesus tell the ten men to do? (1 mark)
   A. Wash in the river
   B. Go and show themselves to the priests
   C. Pay money
   D. Go home

16. What happened after Jesus spoke? (1 mark)
   A. The dead man sat up and began to talk
   B. He ran away
   C. Nothing
   D. The crowd left

17. What does compassion mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being angry
   B. Ignoring others
   C. Laughing at others
   D. Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help

18. What did she do when she found it? (1 mark)
   A. Sold it
   B. Ignored it
   C. Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   D. Hid it

19. What did Joseph do when he was tempted? (1 mark)
   A. Refused and ran away
   B. Told everyone
   C. Stayed to argue
   D. Agreed

20. What does being assertive mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   C. Being silent
   D. Being rude

21. Which commandment says "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:12
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Exodus 20:16

22. If someone says they love you but hurts you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Tell a trusted adult
   C. Keep it secret
   D. Hurt them

23. What did Jesus say to the disciples about the children? (1 mark)
   A. Send them away
   B. Wait for tomorrow
   C. Let them come to me
   D. They are too small

24. How should you care for an exercise book? (1 mark)
   A. Cover it and keep it clean
   B. Tear it
   C. Leave it in the rain
   D. Draw on it

25. Who came to Jesus in the temple after the clearing? (1 mark)
   A. The blind and the lame
   B. Tax collectors
   C. Kings
   D. Soldiers

26. Who helps believers to show the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. The neighbour
   B. The market
   C. The Holy Spirit
   D. The king

27. What does "keep in step with the Spirit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Walk in a line
   B. Dance
   C. Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   D. Run fast

28. Which media can defile a child? (1 mark)
   A. Educational programmes
   B. Violent and ungodly movies
   C. Bible stories
   D. Gospel songs

29. What should you do if something online frightens you? (1 mark)
   A. Keep looking
   B. Keep it secret
   C. Close it and tell a trusted adult
   D. Share it

30. Which is a good use of a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. Listening to a gospel song
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Bullying
   D. Chatting with strangers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State two things the angel Gabriel said about the child that Mary would bear. (2 marks)

32. In your own words, what is a parable and why did Jesus use them? (2 marks)

33. Name two personal items and one way of caring for each. (2 marks)

34. Name two things that Samson did in Judges 14:5-9. (2 marks)

35. Give three rules for staying safe from strangers. (3 marks)

36. Explain the meaning of the word "inspired" when we say the Bible is inspired by God. (3 marks)

37. State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches. (2 marks)

38. Describe how the woman searched for the coin and what she did when she found it. (4 marks)

39. What did Pharaoh's two dreams mean? (2 marks)

40. Write the first two lines of the Lord's Prayer. (2 marks)

41. Describe how Mary responded to the angel's message. (3 marks)

42. Give two examples of personal information that you should not share online. (2 marks)

43. Explain four ways of building self-control. (4 marks)

44. Give three ways in which a child can protect themselves from sexual abuse. (3 marks)

45. Name two of the twelve disciples who were brothers. (2 marks)

46. Give two meanings of the word church. (2 marks)

47. Give two signs of a person with self-control. (2 marks)

48. Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying. (4 marks)

49. Describe four ways of growing the fruit of the Spirit. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   Small acts of kindness like a smile encourage others.

2. B — Take deep breaths and count to ten
   Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

3. B — Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

4. D — Helping her to carry water
   Helping shows respect and care.

5. B — The child of your aunt or uncle
   Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

6. A — Handling the Bible with care
   Care with God's word shows respect.

7. D — To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repentance includes turning away from wrong.

8. D — Half of his possessions
   Zacchaeus said he would give half of his possessions.

9. D — Obey God and speak only what He says
   Balaam had to speak only God's words.

10. B — To respect and love Him and obey Him
   The fear of God is deep respect.

11. C — Second in command over Egypt
   Joseph was put in charge of Egypt, next to Pharaoh.

12. C — Ur
   Abram was born in Ur of the Chaldeans.

13. B — Luke 1:37
   Luke 1:37 is the memory verse of this topic.

14. A — By the roadside near Jericho
   Mark 10:46 says he was by the roadside.

15. B — Go and show themselves to the priests
   Luke 17:14 records this instruction.

16. A — The dead man sat up and began to talk
   Luke 7:15 says he sat up and began to talk.

17. D — Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   Compassion moves us to help.

18. C — Called friends and neighbours to rejoice
   She invited others to celebrate.

19. A — Refused and ran away
   He left his cloak and ran out of the house.

20. B — Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   Assertive means standing for what is right.

21. A — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 says to honour parents.

22. B — Tell a trusted adult
   Love is never hurtful.

23. C — Let them come to me
   Matthew 19:14 records His welcome.

24. A — Cover it and keep it clean
   Covers protect books.

25. A — The blind and the lame
   Matthew 21:14 says He healed them.

26. C — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit grows the fruit.

27. C — Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   Galatians 5:25.

28. B — Violent and ungodly movies
   Harmful media can affect the mind.

29. C — Close it and tell a trusted adult
   Tell someone who can help.

30. A — Listening to a gospel song
   Gospel songs are uplifting.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: He will be great, He will be called Son of the Most High, He will have the throne of David, His kingdom will never end. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid statement.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: A short story used to teach a lesson about God and life. Stories are easy to remember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for story and 1 for teaching a lesson.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Uniform: wash it; exercise book: cover it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with care.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: He killed a lion with his bare hands; he ate honey from the lion's body and shared it with his parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not go with them, do not accept gifts or lifts, do not give personal details, shout for help, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Inspired means that God guided the people who wrote the books. What they wrote is His message to people, so the Bible is God's word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God guiding the writers, 1 for the message being God's, 1 for the conclusion that the Bible is God's word.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: She lit a lamp, swept the house, searched carefully until she found it, then called her friends and neighbours to rejoice with her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for plenty and 1 mark for famine.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. (The wording "who art in heaven" is also accepted.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was troubled at first, asked how it could happen since she was a virgin, and then accepted, saying she was the Lord's servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for being troubled or asking, 1 for how, 1 for accepting.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Home address, school, phone number, passwords, family photos.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray each morning, set small goals, keep busy with good activities, choose good friends, avoid tempting situations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, run away, do not accept gifts from strangers, avoid being alone in hidden places, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Peter and Andrew; James and John.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: The building where Christians worship; the community of believers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Waits turn, controls anger, shares, saves money.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, practise one fruit at a time, ask for encouragement, say sorry and try again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.
